name: Vijay Sankeshwar
current_role: Founder & Chairman, VRL Logistics / VRL Group (Hubballi, Karnataka)
profile: Born 1950 in Gadag, Karnataka. He started a cargo business in 1976 with one truck and built VRL Logistics into one of India's largest commercial-vehicle fleet owners. He also founded the Kannada newspaper Vijaya Karnataka (sold to the Times Group in 2007) and later Vijaya Vani, and was a BJP MP for Dharwad North. He is chairman, and his son Anand runs VRL as MD.
interesting_fact: His life story, from a single truck to India's largest logistics fleet, became the 2022 multilingual biopic 'Vijayanand'. He received the Padma Shri in 2020.
deep_cut_fact: He started in 1976 with one truck bought on a Rs 2 lakh loan and took heavy early losses from accidents and competition. In 1978 the family moved to Hubballi and added three more trucks. His father ran a printing press, B G Sankeshwar & Co., in Gadag.
notes: Both emails appear in VRL's FY2025-26 BRSR filing on NSE. The filing also lists the Company Secretary, Aniruddha Phadnavis (aniruddha@vrllogistics.com), as compliance contact. Better known in Karnataka media and politics. Family-owned Kannada media (Vijaya Vani, Digvijay 24x7) are another route.
